summary.text: Carlisle Kennedy is a Republican from Lexington who represents Senate District 23 (Lexington County) in the South Carolina Senate and serves on the Banking and Insurance, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Rules committees.

paragraphs.text: Kennedy is an attorney who graduated from Clemson University with a B.S. and an M.B.A. and was student body president in 2011-2012; he received his J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 2019.

He served as a commissioner of the S.C. Commission on Consumer Affairs from 2014 to 2020 and as an assistant solicitor in the 11th Judicial Circuit from 2019 to 2022, and has practiced with the Kennedy Law Firm since 2022.
